title: Green Streets at Night · P2 Background
speaker: P2 Mina Park

sections.title: Why are summer nights getting hotter?

cues.text: Quick poll first. Raise your hand if you could not sleep because of the heat last summer. That is a lot of hands.
I am one of them. Alex, did you know the night is where cities and the countryside differ most?
cues.note: 我也是其中一個。Alex，你知道城市和鄉下差最多的其實是晚上嗎？

cues.text: Really? I thought the afternoon was the worst part.
The afternoon is hot everywhere. But after sunset, the countryside cools down fast. The city does not.
cues.note: 下午到處都熱。但太陽下山以後，鄉下很快就涼了，城市卻不會。

cues.text: Concrete and asphalt store heat during the day. At night they slowly give it back, like a warm stone in your hand.
cues.note: 水泥和柏油白天把熱存起來，晚上再慢慢放出來，就像手裡握著一顆溫熱的石頭。

cues.text: Scientists call this the urban heat island. In some cities, nights are now five degrees warmer than nearby fields.
cues.note: 科學家把這叫做都市熱島。有些城市的夜晚，現在比附近的田野熱上五度。

cues.text: So it is not just about comfort?
No. Hot nights mean poor sleep, and older people are at real risk. That is why this paper looks at the night, not the day.
cues.note: 不只。熱夜代表睡不好，年長者更有真正的健康風險。這就是為什麼這篇論文看的是夜晚，而不是白天。

sections.title: Trees as the city's air conditioner

cues.text: So how do trees fit in, Mina?
Trees help in two ways. First, shade. A shaded road stores much less heat during the day, so it has less to give back at night.
cues.note: 樹有兩種幫忙的方式。第一是遮蔭。有遮蔭的路面白天存的熱少很多，晚上要放的熱也就少。

cues.text: Second, water. Leaves release water into the air. That works like sweat on your skin, and it cools the air around the tree.
cues.note: 第二是水分。葉子會把水分釋放到空氣中，就像皮膚上的汗，讓樹周圍的空氣變涼。

cues.text: We know this works in the afternoon. But at night there is no sun to block, and leaves release much less water.
cues.note: 我們知道這在下午有效。但晚上沒有太陽可以擋，葉子釋放的水分也少很多。

cues.text: So the open question was: do trees still cool a street after dark? And does one tree help, or do you need many?
cues.note: 所以還沒有答案的問題是：天黑以後，樹還能讓街道變涼嗎？一棵樹就有用，還是需要很多棵？

cues.text: The authors ask two questions. RQ1: does more tree cover on a street mean a cooler night on that street?
cues.note: 作者問了兩個問題。RQ1：一條街的樹冠越多，那條街的夜晚就越涼嗎？

cues.text: RQ2: does it matter how the trees are placed? For example, a few big trees in a row, or many small trees spread out?
cues.note: RQ2：樹怎麼種有差嗎？例如一排幾棵大樹，還是很多小樹分散種？

cues.text: To answer them, they put sensors on sixty streets for a whole summer. Leo will tell you how.
cues.note: 為了回答這些問題，他們在六十條街上放了一整個夏天的感測器。接下來請 Leo 說明他們怎麼做。
